title: Shift compatibility of open extension and restriction
statement: Fix $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$, a prime $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}k$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $R$ and uniformizer $t$, and $A_n=R/t^n$ for $n\ge1$. For finite-type $k$-schemes $W$ with their small pro-etale sites put $\widehat R_W=\lim_n(A_n)_W$, and let $\mathscr S_W$ be the abelian category of strict semilinear systems of $(A_n)_W$-module sheaves, with its ordinary unbounded derived category, derived reduction $\mathcal R_W$ and total-limit functor $\mathcal L_W=R\lim\operatorname{Res}$ of [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus]; regard $\mathscr S_W$ as the module category of the ring diagram $((A_n)_W)_n$ on the simultaneous ringed diagram site of [lem-sf-integral-compactification-system-realization]. For a quasi-compact open immersion $j:U\hookrightarrow W$, let $J_j:D(\mathscr S_U)\to D(\mathscr S_W)$ be exact termwise open extension by zero and $P_j$ restriction; $J_j$ is left adjoint to $P_j$, using the localized-site extension-by-zero adjunction of [lem-pur-site-restriction-module-adjunction-exact] on the ringed diagram site. Equip both functors with their termwise cochain-shift comparisons. The unit and counit of $J_j\dashv P_j$ commute with every integer shift, naturally in the system complexes; the assertion is an equality of system maps before finite evaluation and total limit.

proof.text: Since $j$ is an open immersion, it is etale and $U$ is an object of $W_{\mathrm{proet}}$. For each $n$, [lem-pur-site-restriction-module-adjunction-exact] on $(W_{\mathrm{proet}},(A_n)_W)$ at the object $U$ gives exact restriction $j^*$ and exact extension by zero $j_{!,n}$ with $j_{!,n}\dashv j^*$; these are the exact fiber adjunctions $L_n\dashv P_n$. Apply [lem-pur-sequence-site-open-extension] with $B_n=(A_n)_W$. It identifies restriction and extension on the actual sequence site with these levelwise functors, with coefficient comparisons $\alpha_n$ (and the identity $\beta_n$ for restriction) compatible with the units and counits, i.e. the two displayed equations of [lem-pur-inverse-section-adjunction-gluing]. Apply that lemma using the scalar restrictions, which are exact by [def-coef-semilinear-system-models], as the transition functors. This yields the exact abelian system adjunction with levelwise units, counits and triangles. By [def-weil-exact-derived-adjunction] its termwise cochain adjunction localizes with precisely these maps. This is the specified exact termwise $J_j\dashv P_j$ in [lem-sf-integral-compactification-system-realization].

source.place: paragraph 2: open adjunction units and counits; reassembly step 1

proof.text: Apply [lem-pur-exact-adjunction-unit-shift-descent] to this exact abelian system adjunction. Its comparisons are precisely the prescribed termwise ones, including the signed differentials and the zero/addition coherence, so its localized unit equation is the required unit square for every integer $a$. Part (i) of [lem-weil-pbc-adjunction-shift-compatibility-unique] gives the counit square. Parts (ii) and (iii) identify the fixed right comparison as the unique compatible shift structure for the fixed left comparison.

proof.text: These equations hold as natural transformations in the ordinary derived categories of strict semilinear systems themselves. Applying finite evaluation or the total-limit functor transports equal morphisms to equal morphisms. Thus the required equalities precede either operation, naturally in every system complex.
